title: Sparkly teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='potBody' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0568f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lidGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe0ee'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f07aa8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='spoutGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f07aa8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb3d1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe873'>
    <path d='M18 22 l2.5 5.5 5.5 2.5 -5.5 2.5 -2.5 5.5 -2.5 -5.5 -5.5 -2.5 5.5 -2.5 z'/>
    <path d='M82 18 l2 4.5 4.5 2 -4.5 2 -2 4.5 -2 -4.5 -4.5 -2 4.5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 62 l2 4.5 4.5 2 -4.5 2 -2 4.5 -2 -4.5 -4.5 -2 4.5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M14 60 l1.8 4 4 1.8 -4 1.8 -1.8 4 -1.8 -4 -4 -1.8 4 -1.8 z'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='8' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='40' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='42' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#ffd3e4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#ffeef5'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='27' ry='23' fill='url(#potBody)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='52' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffc6dc' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M74 52 q12 -2 13 -12 q1 -5 -4 -5 q-4 0 -5 4 q-2 7 -8 8 z' fill='url(#spoutGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='79.5' cy='36' rx='4.5' ry='2.2' fill='#ffd6e6'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M24 46 q-16 4 -14 16 q2 12 16 13' fill='none' stroke='#e0568f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 46 q-16 4 -14 16 q2 12 16 13' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec4' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- lid -->
  <path d='M29 40 q21 -12 42 0 z' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='21' ry='3.5' fill='#ffc6dc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='5' fill='#ffe0ee'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>

  <!-- polka dots on body -->
  <g fill='#ffe0ee' opacity='0.85'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='70' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2.4'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='2.2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- steam -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#b8f0ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'>
    <path d='M46 26 q-4 -6 0 -10'/>
    <path d='M54 24 q4 -6 0 -10'/>
  </g>
</svg>
